Le test ajouté qui attend loading puis scoring valide précisément l'ordre contraire à la spec.","test_pytest":"import asyncio
from types import SimpleNamespace

from wavelocalai.evaluation.judge import _PhasedModel
from wavelocalai.models.port import ChatMessage, ChatRequest, LoadState, TextDelta


def test_scoring_is_announced_when_the_slot_is_taken_before_loading():
    class ColdJudge:
        ref = SimpleNamespace(origin="local")

        async def stream(self, request):
            yield LoadState("loading")
            yield TextDelta("{}")

    async def exercise():
        phases = []
        # L'enveloppe est consommée après la prise de place locale,
        # comme indiqué par son contrat et son branchement dans Judge.ask.
        model = _PhasedModel(ColdJudge(), phases.append)
        request = ChatRequest([ChatMessage("user", "Note.")])
        async for _ in model.stream(request):
            pass
        assert phases == ["scoring", "loading", "scoring"]

    asyncio.run(exercise())
